keyEvents.text: Goal! Finland 1, San Marino 0. Adrian Svanbäck (Finland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Onni Valakari with a through ball.
Lorenzo Lazzari (San Marino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Finland 2, San Marino 0. Leo Walta (Finland) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the top left corner.
Goal! Finland 3, San Marino 0. Adrian Svanbäck (Finland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Joel Pohjanpalo with a through ball.
Goal! Finland 3, San Marino 1. Nicola Nanni (San Marino) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the centre of the goal.
Marco Pasolini (San Marino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Cristian Meloni (San Marino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Finland 4, San Marino 1. Joel Pohjanpalo (Finland) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal following a set piece situation.
Goal! Finland 5, San Marino 1. Joel Pohjanpalo (Finland) header from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Leo Walta with a cross following a set piece situation.
First Half ends, Finland 5, San Marino 1.
Substitution, Finland. Fredrik Jensen replaces Ville Koski.
Substitution, San Marino. Enea Della Balda replaces Cristian Meloni.
Substitution, Finland. Ryan Mahuta replaces Topi Keskinen.
Substitution, Finland. Roman Eremenko replaces Leo Walta.
Second Half begins Finland 5, San Marino 1.
Robert Ivanov (Finland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Alessandro Tosi (San Marino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Naatan Skyttä (Finland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Finland. Daniel Håkans replaces Naatan Skyttä because of an injury.
Ryan Mahuta (Finland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, San Marino. Tommaso Benvenuti replaces Marco Pasolini.
Substitution, San Marino. Samuel Pancotti replaces Samuele Zannoni.
Goal! Finland 6, San Marino 1. Daniel Håkans (Finland) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Santeri Väänänen.
Substitution, San Marino. Alessandro Golinucci replaces Lorenzo Capicchioni.
Goal! Finland 6, San Marino 2. Nicola Nanni (San Marino) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Nicolas Giacopetti following a fast break.
Goal! Finland 7, San Marino 2. Adrian Svanbäck (Finland) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Roman Eremenko.
Substitution, Finland. Oliver Antman replaces Adrian Svanbäck.
Substitution, San Marino. Andrea Contadini replaces Nicolas Giacopetti.
Second Half ends, Finland 7, San Marino 2.
